jamestown-mural-walk-and-outdoor-gallery.name: Jamestown Mural Walk and Outdoor Gallery
jamestown-mural-walk-and-outdoor-gallery.bio: Self-guided walk past heritage-building murals on Jamestown's main streets, ending at an outdoor gallery on Ayr Street.

notes.pin: Outdoor Gallery at the east end of Ayr Street, Jamestown; walk starts at the visitor outlet on Ayr Street. Pin the gallery or the middle of the Ayr Street murals.
notes.cost: Free, outdoor street walk (no price stated on the listing).

jamestown-mural-walk-and-outdoor-gallery.ticket_note: No single steward site verified; the listing is a tourism-board page, not an operator site.

jamestown-railway-station-museum.name: Jamestown Railway Station Museum
jamestown-railway-station-museum.bio: Local-history museum in Jamestown's 1885 railway station, with an 1870s carriage and displays on R.M. Williams.

notes.pin: Historic Jamestown railway station (built 1885), Jamestown town.
notes.cost: Entry fee and any official site not stated on the listing; unverified.

bowman-park.name: Bowman Park
bowman-park.bio: Public park near Crystal Brook with river red gums, a spring-fed brook, a nature playground and a Heysen Trail section.

notes.pin: Draft point is Wikipedia's rounded article coordinate (park centroid); re-pin to the park's car park or day-use area about 5 km NE of Crystal Brook.
notes.cost: Public park open sunrise to sunset; Wikipedia states no fee; not on parks.sa.gov.au (404), so council-run; treated as free.
notes.region: Near Crystal Brook, about 60 km from Clare; Wikipedia places it in the Mid North; Flinders/Yorke region call is the owner's.
notes.dropped_from_bio: 1850s homestead ruins not confirmed in a fetched source, so left out.
